location.section: Art. 60 B) as rewritten by the renewal of 7 March 2024 (comporto, 36-month window)
location.quote: 1) mesi 8 per gli aventi anzianità di servizio fino a 3 anni 2) mesi 10 per gli aventi anzianità di servizio fino a 6 anni 3) mesi 12 per gli aventi anzianità di servizio oltre i 6 anni.

provenance.transformation: Comporto 8, 10, 12 months (240, 300, 360 days of 30-day months) within 36 months (renewal p. 8: 'si intendono riferiti ad un arco temporale di 36 mesi'); pay (CNEL p. 77, art. 60 C): 'intera retribuzione netta' for 3, 4, 5 months and half for 5, 6, 7 more, so the half runs to the end of the comporto; on the net pay (net_basis). The treatment restarts after 'un periodo di quattro mesi senza alcuna assenza per malattia' (reset_after_days 120). Bands from 36 and 72 completed months for 'fino a 3 anni' and 'fino a 6 anni'. Malattie invalidanti (renewal p. 7): 'I termini sopra indicati sono aumentati rispettivamente di 2 mesi, 3 mesi e 4 mesi' (300, 390, 480 days, SicknessEpisode.serious_illness); hospital stays: 'non saranno tenuti in considerazione i periodi di ricovero ospedaliero di durata superiore a 5 giorni [...] continuativi di calendario fino ad un massimo di 60 complessivi' (SicknessEpisode.hospital_stays), counted over the 36-month window. Restart: 'Il trattamento economico suindicato ricomincia ex novo [...] dal 16° giorno di ricovero ospedaliero' (CNEL text p. 88, art. 60 C): from the 16th day of a stay the days count from one again (hospital_restart_day), within the episode. Restart also for an 'assenza per malattia iniziata dopo dodici mesi dal giorno in cui è cessato il diritto al trattamento economico del 100%' (art. 60 C, restart_after_full_pay_months 12); the 'giorni di controlli periodici rivolti ai lavoratori che hanno avuto esperienza oncologica' of a malattia invalidante are left out of the comporto (renewal p. 7, SicknessEpisode.periodic_check).
provenance.note: Scanned renewal, read by OCR and checked on the page images. Group 3 (operai) receive the INPS indemnity topped up to the net pay of group 1.

location.section: Art. 83 (preavviso); Art. 26 (classificazione), PDF p. 51
location.quote:
Art. 83 - Preavviso di licenziamento e di dimissioni
Il rapporto di lavoro a tempo indeterminato di un lavoratore non in prova non può essere risolto da nes-
suna delle due parti senza un periodo di preavviso i cui termini sono stabiliti come segue a seconda
dell’anzianità e della qualifica a cui appartiene il lavoratore.
Il periodo di preavviso non può coincidere con il periodo di ferie.
La parte che risolve il rapporto senza l’osservanza dei termini di preavviso di cui ai seguenti punti a), b),
c), deve corrispondere all’altra un’indennità pari all’importo della retribuzione per il periodo di mancato
preavviso. Il datore di lavoro ha diritto di ritenere su quanto sia da lui dovuto al lavoratore un importo
corrispondente alla retribuzione per il periodo di preavviso da questo eventualmente non prestato.
a) Lavoratori di cui al gruppo 3) dell’art. 26:
il licenziamento o le dimissioni del lavoratore, non in prova, attuati non ai sensi dell’art. 21, possono
aver luogo in qualunque giorno della settimana, con preavviso di 6 giorni per anzianità ininterrotta fino
ad un anno e di 15 giorni per anzianità superiori.
b) Lavoratori di cui al gruppo 2) dell’art. 26:
il lavoratore di cui al gruppo 2) dell’art. 26 ha diritto ai seguenti termini di preavviso di licenziamento,
con decorrenza dalla metà o dalla fine di ciascun mese:


                                                            Cat. C1ª                      Cat. D2ª
     Anni di servizio
                                                            (ex liv.5°)                   (ex liv.3°)
fino a 5 anni compiuti                                       1 mese                       1/2 mese
oltre 5 anni e fino a 10 anni compiuti                     1 mese e 1/2                    1 mese
oltre 10 anni                                                2 mesi                      1 mese e 1/2


In caso di dimissioni i termini di cui sopra sono ridotti alla metà.
c) Lavoratori di cui ai gruppi Q) e 1) dell’art. 26:
Il lavoratore di cui ai gruppi Q) e 1) dell’art. 26 ha diritto ai seguenti termini di preavviso, con decorrenza
dalla metà o dalla fine di ciascun mese:


                                           Cat. A, B1ª e B2ª               Cat. C1ª            Altre Cat.
     Anni di servizio
                                           (ex liv.8°, 7° e 6°)            (ex liv.5°)       (ex altri livelli)
fino a 5 anni compiuti                            2 mesi                  1 mese e 1/2           1 mese
oltre 5 anni e fino a 10 anni compiuti            3 mesi                    2 mesi            1 mese e 1/2
oltre 10 anni                                     4 mesi                    3 mesi               2 mesi


In caso di dimissioni i termini di cui sopra sono ridotti alla metà.

provenance.transformation: Bands proposed by a delegated search and checked band by band against the PDF by a separate session. A start day the text does not set is read as the day after the notice; the ratei of the extra months and the TFR treatment are set only where the text states them.

notes.text: SALARY MODEL: split. base_salary = minimo tabellare (Allegato n. 1, CCNL 07/03/2024). EDR = 10.33 EUR (Accordo 31/07/1992, all levels). IPO = Indennità di posizione organizzativa, level-specific time series per tranche (levels B1, C1, D1, E1, E2). IND_FUNZIONE = 25.82 EUR (level A only, Indennità di funzione, art. 47 CCNL 2017). Back-calculation: D1 total 01/01/2026 = 2041.99+123.67+10.33 = 2175.99; kitech confirms 2176.00 (rounding). B1 total = 2494.04+222.01+10.33 = 2726.38; kitech confirms 2726.38. A total = 2937.60+25.82+10.33 = 2973.75; kitech confirms 2973.75.

DECORRENZA: economic decorrenza 01/07/2023; first tranche 01/03/2024. Arretrati for 2023-07-01 to 2024-03-01 paid as lump sum. Series starts at 2024-03-01. SIMPLIFICATION: pre-tranche salary not modeled.
HOURLY DIVISOR: contract states 'quota oraria = retribuzione mensile / 173' (Allegato n. 1). Cross-check: 40h/week × 52 / 12 = 173.3; divisor 173 verified. Source: primary CCNL PDF filctemcgil.it.

SENIORITY: biennial (cadence_months=24), maximum 5 increments, amounts per level from Art. 48 of the CCNL testo definitivo 21/01/2021 (CNEL B101, physical p. 67), which the 2024 renewal leaves unchanged.

IPO CROSS-CHECK: MySolution 2017 IPO at 01/05/2019: B1=182.63, C1=91.62, D1=103.98, E1=128.23, E2=73.02. Allegato n.1 pre-renewal (30/06/2023): B1=192.63, C1=96.62, D1=108.98, E1=135.73, E2=75.52. Deltas B1+10.00, C1+5.00, D1+5.00, E1+7.50, E2+2.50 — all clean round figures consistent with 2019-2023 renewal cycle.

APPRENTICESHIP: under_classification per MySolution sintesi 2017 p. 5 (Allegato apprendistato). 6 tracks by destination level, all with levels_below 2 → 1 → 0. D1 period-2: source table prints E2, but 10 of 11 destination tracks are monotone 2->1->0; E2 (order 3) below D1 (order 6) would cut pay mid-track, so D2 (order 5, exactly 1 below D1) is the only consistent reading. Max 36 months per D.Lgs. 167/2011 as amended 26/04/2012 (footnote in source).

OVERTIME: every band of art. 35 is modelled: 15% to the 48th weekly hour, 25% the 49th, 35% beyond; night 61% the first hour, 76% after (first hour read per day); holiday 71%. The percentages do not add up ('la maggiore assorbe la minore', p. 57). The engine pays the first tier of an overtime event and flags the bands past a threshold (overtime_tier_not_applied): the caller passes the multiplier for the hours past a threshold.

limitation.remediation: Pass the multiplier on the overtime event for the hours past a threshold; the engine does not split an event by weekly or daily hours.

notes.text: DAILY DIVISOR: Art. 51 b) of the CCNL testo definitivo 21/01/2021 (CNEL B101, physical pp. 69-70) deducts the normal hours not worked by the ratio 173 / working hours of the month; Art. 50 keeps the quota of 1/25 for the holidays falling on a Sunday. Modelled as by_month_hours: one share per Monday to Friday out of the Mondays to Fridays of the month.

LEAVE: Art. 42 of the CCNL testo definitivo 21/01/2021 (CNEL B101, physical p. 62): 4 weeks (20 days) up to the 10th year of service completed; 4 weeks + 2 days beyond the 10th year (120 months); 4 weeks + 3 days beyond the 15th (180 months); 5 weeks (25 days) beyond the 18th (216 months). ROL 68 ore/anno not modelled.

limitation.remediation: Add a rol bucket of 68 hours a year to leave_rules with its accrual and payout (Art. 42 / ROL article).

notes.text: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: SICKNESS: seniority bands of art. 60 modelled as a cumulation (8, 10, 12 months of comporto within 36 months; 3, 4, 5 months in full and the rest at half, on the net pay); restarts after 4 months without sickness, from the 16th day of a hospital stay (within the episode) and 12 months after the end of the full pay; comporto 2, 3, 4 months longer for an invalidating disease; hospital stays over 5 days (60 at most) and periodic checks of an oncological illness left out of the comporto.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded; no value was marked verified.
findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.

reviews.scope: Every payable rule of the file (98 records) read again in the signed texts: the renewal of 7 March 2024 and the CCNL testo definitivo of 21 January 2021 deposited at CNEL (B101), which the 2024 renewal leaves unchanged for these articles.
findings: 96 records match their source and are verified; the two corrected rules below are verified too. The 34 records that cited the mysolution.it summary sheet now cite the CNEL testo definitivo. Pages are physical PDF pages (the printed page of the CNEL text is two lower).
Corrected: the leave tiers of Art. 42 start after the 10th and the 15th year (120 and 180 months), not 132 and 192.
Corrected: Art. 51 b) deducts unworked hours by the ratio 173 / working hours of the month, and Art. 50 keeps 1/25 for Sunday holidays, so the absence rule is by_month_hours instead of by_25.
Not modelled, each underpaying: night overtime after the first hour (76%), the 25% and 35% bands for daytime overtime beyond 48 hours, and the sickness tiers of 10 and 12 months for longer service.
The IND_FUNZIONE clause is Art. 46 g), not Art. 47.
No renewal signed after 7 March 2024; the contract expired on 30 June 2026 and a renewal is under negotiation.

reviews.scope: Overtime bands of art. 35 and the sickness rule of art. 60, follow-ups of the review of 2026-10-11.
findings: Overtime: the 25% (49th weekly hour), 35% (beyond) and 76% (night after the first hour) bands were missing; added, the night threshold read per day.

Sickness: only the band up to 3 years was modelled, per episode and on the gross pay; now three seniority bands within 36 months, on the net pay, with the restart after 4 months without sickness (derived: months of 30 days, band edges read on completed months).

reviews.scope: Special cases of the comporto (art. 60 B as rewritten on 7 March 2024).
findings: The longer comporto of the malattie invalidanti (+2, +3, +4 months) and the hospital stays over 5 days left out of the comporto (60 days at most) are now modelled; the restart from the 16th day of a hospital stay and the periodic checks stay a limitation.

reviews.scope: Restart of the sickness treatment from the 16th day of a hospital stay (art. 60 C).
findings: From the 16th day of a hospital stay the treatment starts anew (full pay again): modelled with hospital_restart_day 16.

reviews.scope: Restart 12 months after the end of the full pay and periodic checks (art. 60).
findings: The last special cases of art. 60 are modelled: the restart 12 months after the full pay ended and the periodic checks out of the comporto; the limitation sickness_special_cases is closed.

reviews.scope: The notice clause (Art. 83 (preavviso); Art. 26 (classificazione), PDF p. 51, p. 88).
findings: Notice bands by level, category and service checked against the PDF by a separate session (delegated search and independent verification): work_rules.notice.
